name: Stormbringer: High Voltage extends Arm of Thorim's stun (#2154)
contract: #2154: High Voltage (570191) is a passive flat SPELLMOD_DURATION (EffectMiscValue[0] 1) modifier, EffectBasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask[0] (0,0,16777216), SpellFamilyName 22. Arm of Thorim (501433) triggers its stun 570339 through Spell::EffectTriggerSpell (SpellEffects.cpp), and 570339 is family 22 with SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,16777216) and DurationIndex 36 (1000 ms), so the mask matches that stun and nothing else. Aura::CalcMaxDuration (SpellAuras.cpp) feeds the stun's duration through Player::ApplySpellMod on the caster, the same call the spell_modifier metric makes, so the live triggered stun is raised from the 1000 ms DBC base to 2000 ms. The two halves deliberately use two different dummies: SpellMgr::LoadSpellInfoCorrections (src/server/game/Spells/SpellInfoCorrections.cpp) gives 570339 Mechanic MECHANIC_STUN, so GetDiminishingReturnsGroupForSpell (SpellMgr.cpp) returns DIMINISHING_CONTROLLED_STUN, whose type is DRTYPE_ALL (GetDiminishingReturnsGroupType), i.e. diminishing returns that also apply to creatures. Spell::DoSpellHitOnUnit calls Unit::IncrDiminishing on the first stun and Unit::ApplyDiminishingToDuration (mod 0.5f at DIMINISHING_LEVEL_2, Unit.cpp) on any further stun landing on the same unit within 15 s, which would halve the extended 2000 ms back to exactly 1000 ms and make a working talent look broken. Diminishing returns are tracked per target unit (Unit::m_Diminishing), so the discriminating cast lands on a dummy that has never been stunned. Arm of Thorim is gated by the class-16 custom resource system (AscensionCompatData::ResourceCostRules, src/server/coa/AscensionCustomResourceData.h): it requires at least 1 stack of the 'Static' resource aura 803102 and consumes it entirely on cast (Consumption::All), so the fixture grants 1 stack before each cast. The three DISCRIMINATING assertions separate the mechanism into its stages: the passive's own aura must reach the caster, Player::ApplySpellMod must accept the modifier for 570339 (read through spell_modifier, which needs no cast and no timing), and Aura::CalcMaxDuration must apply it to the live triggered stun. aura_duration_ms reads the remaining duration, so the live windows allow one tick of decay.
